flags.why: “Đầu phố” means the beginning of the street, not the end.
flags.fix: The whole neighbourhood is afraid of the thugs at the beginning of the street.

flags.why: “Bái” is formal or literary language for bowing in worship or respect.
“Nệm” is mainly Southern usage for a mattress.
Both examples use “dưới trướng” to mean being under someone's command rather than referring to a canopy or curtain.
flags.fix: Bức trướng che quanh giường. = The curtain hangs around the bed.

flags.why: “Lâm nguy” is formal or literary language for being in peril.
